study: F3 WP3.2 slice S2: lunar albedo and thermal-IR radiation pressure (LRP) as an opt-in production force term (REQ-DYN-007, DYN-07)
written: 2026-11-10, before any S2 code, test or number. Read before writing: the C6 model (studies/phase17/scripts/phase_c6_lunar_radiation.py) and its tests, the WP3.1 study term (wp3_1_force_terms.lrp_acceleration), srp.py (SRPOptions, solar_pressure_at), the dynamics.py SRP and tide wrappers and propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity, accelerated.py (the optional-numba pattern), the S1 identity script and the S1 T_G5 margin diagnostic. One measurement was made: the C6 numpy kernel costs 3.7 ms per single-point call on this machine (300 calls), which rules it out as the production kernel. No S2 code, test or gate value exists
base: branch f3/wp3-2-s2-lrp from f3/wp3-2-force-terms 71ec7ee (S1, PR #116), stacked on #116
scope_decision: WP3.1-R decision 2026-11-08 (owner delegated to the agent; survey report section 9): LRP goes in as an opt-in term, defaults and frozen results unchanged, and LRP enters the K_SRP sensitivity because it scales with the same area-to-mass ratio. S2 is the second WP3.2 slice
question: Does the production propagator, with opt-in LRP, integrate the term WP3.1 found material (165 sigma), with a variational gradient and K_SRP sensitivity that match it and a quadrature whose error stays far below the materiality threshold, without changing any existing path (default or tide-on)?

physics.model: the C6 model, unchanged: the Moon a uniform Lambertian sphere of radius R; each surface element of the cap visible from the spacecraft emits radiance L = [A F cos+(psi) + eps sigma T^4] / pi, with A the Bond albedo, F the solar flux at the Moon (solar_pressure_at(|r_sun|) c), psi the solar incidence angle, and T = max(T_ss cos+(psi)^(1/4), T_night), eps sigma T_ss^4 = (1 - A) F (instantaneous radiative equilibrium). The cannonball absorbs from every direction with the SRP convention: a = K / c * sum_elements L cos(e) dA / d^2 * u, u the unit vector from the element to the spacecraft, e the emission angle
physics.parameters: C6 defaults: A = 0.12, eps = 0.95, T_night = 100 K, R = R_MOON_M = 1737.4 km, quadrature 60 Gauss-Legendre rings (theta = theta_max x^2) x 72 azimuth sectors around the nadir, with C6's nadir frame (seed axis x unless |z_x| >= 0.9, then y)
physics.k: K_LRP = K_SRP: one cannonball, as in C6 and WP3.1. The acceleration is K times a K-independent kernel g_LRP(r, r_sun), so d a / dK = g_LRP and K = 0 stays a legal starting point
physics.gradient: dg_LRP/dr is the exact derivative of the discrete quadrature sum, by forward-mode differentiation through the node geometry (nadir frame, theta_max(r), node normals, element-to-spacecraft vectors, emission cosines, element weights, incidence cosines and the active branch of each piecewise radiance). The frame seed and the active branches are piecewise constant, so their derivative is zero. G_LRP is not symmetric: the radiation force is not conservative
physics.size: at 100 km over the subsolar point g_LRP K ~ 4e-8 m/s^2 for K = 0.01 (C6: arc RMS 2.1e-8, max 4.2e-8). Its position gradient is ~1e-14 s^-2, about 3e-8 of the central gravity gradient and 3e-2 of the S1 tide gradient
physics.frame: none needed: a uniform sphere needs only the Moon-centred Sun position, which the SRP term already uses
physics.requirement: WP3.1's LRP response is 165 sigma, so a model error that is a fraction f of the term moves the solution by up to about 165 f sigma. Keeping that below 0.1 sigma with a factor 2 margin requires f <= 0.1 / 165 / 2 = 3e-4 relative. This sets the L_G3(c) threshold

design.module: new src/lunar_od/lunar_radiation.py: frozen keyword-only LunarRadiationOptions(albedo=0.12, emissivity=0.95, night_temperature_k=100.0, n_theta=60, n_phi=72, radius_m=R_MOON_M, provenance=<C6 model and WP3.1 decision>); lunar_radiation_acceleration_per_k(r_sc, r_sun, options) -> (3,); lunar_radiation_gradient_per_k(...) -> (3, 3); lunar_radiation_acceleration_and_gradient_per_k(...). Loop kernels under accelerated.py's _optional_njit(cache=True), no fastmath; without numba the same code runs as Python (correct, slow). The Gauss-Legendre nodes are computed once per n_theta and passed in
design.validation: albedo finite in [0, 1); emissivity finite in (0, 1]; night temperature finite and >= 0; n_theta and n_phi integers (not bool) with n_theta >= 4 and n_phi >= 8; radius finite and > 0; a lunar_radiation that is neither None nor LunarRadiationOptions raises TypeError; at propagation, lunar_radiation without an active SRPOptions (srp None or disabled) raises ValueError, because K_LRP = K_SRP has no value otherwise
design.dynamics: dynamics._with_lunar_radiation_acceleration(rhs, get_sun_pos, srp, lunar_radiation, *, state_size) returns rhs ITSELF when lunar_radiation is None. Otherwise: 6-state adds K g_LRP to elements 3:6 and never evaluates the gradient; 42-state also adds K G_LRP @ Phi[0:3, :] to rows 3:6 of Phi_dot; 48-state also adds K G_LRP @ s_K[0:3] + g_LRP to s_K_dot[3:6] (the second term is the LRP part of df/dK). It is applied after the tide wrapper; the Sun lookup is the one _share_sun_lookup already caches for active SRP
design.keywords: lunar_radiation=None (keyword-only, appended last) wherever S1 added lunar_tide: propagate_state, shadow_contact_times, propagate_augmented_state (plain and harmonic path), propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity, propagate_truth_with_ephemeris, _build_state_rhs, _propagate_augmented_with_harmonics. The D2 contact pre-pass integrates the same LRP-on RHS
design.transport_S2b: propagation_contract.model_options and propagator_options(srp, propagation_profile, lunar_tide=None, lunar_radiation=None): the key 'lunar_radiation' appears only when a LunarRadiationOptions is given. The 15 estimators.py functions that carry lunar_tide gain lunar_radiation=None and forward it to every propagation, as S1 did for the tide
design.deferred: as S1: UKF, EKF, fast sigma, scenarios, scenario_config, CLI, desktop, observability, numerical_metadata, force contract. None of them can enable LRP (fail closed by absence). They join with the scenario-level transport after S4

gates.L_G1_DEFAULT_IDENTITY: (a) _with_lunar_radiation_acceleration(rhs, ..., None, state_size=k) is rhs (object identity) for k in {6, 42, 48}. (b) New script studies/phase17/scripts/wp3_2_s2_default_identity.py runs the S1 T_G1(b) configuration set twice: once as in S1, and once with lunar_tide = LunarTideOptions(TIDE_FREE) added to every call (so S1's new tide-on behaviour is protected too), 50 configurations. Byte-identical SHA-256 of every output: before the change (this branch's base, run twice) and after it with lunar_radiation omitted and with lunar_radiation=None. Information, not gated: the tide-free half against S1's recorded hashes
gates.L_G2_C6_PARITY: 200 samples, seed 20261110: spacecraft radius uniform in [R_MOON + 20 km, R_MOON + 3000 km], Sun distance uniform in [0.983, 1.017] AU, isotropic directions. The production per-K kernel (numba) and its Python fallback (py_func) equal the C6 study kernel phase_c6_lunar_radiation.acceleration_kernel with its default LunarRadiation, which is the WP3.1 term divided by K, to <= 1e-12 |a_C6|
gates.L_G3_ACCURACY: (a) Night cap, closed form: spacecraft on the anti-solar axis at altitudes 20, 100, 1000 and 3000 km (the visible cap is all night side, L uniform): a = eps sigma T_night^4 (R/r)^2 / c along r_hat, to <= 1e-10 relative. (b) Sub-solar axis, 1-D oracle: spacecraft on the Sun direction at the same altitudes (the whole cap on the thermal branch, L = F cos(psi) / pi): the radial component equals a scipy.integrate.quad 1-D integral over the polar angle (epsrel 1e-13) to <= 1e-10 relative, the transverse components <= 1e-12 |a|. (c) General geometry against an independent adaptive reference: nested scipy.integrate.quad_vec over the visible cap in a Sun-aligned azimuth frame, with breakpoints at both radiance kinks (cos psi = 0 and the thermal floor) in azimuth and at their tangencies in polar angle, epsrel 1e-11. Precondition: the reference reproduces (a) and (b) to 1e-10. Grid: altitudes {20, 100, 1000} km x Sun-to-nadir angle {0, 45, 80, 90, 100, 135, 180} deg, the frame azimuth drawn with seed 20261110: max |a_prod - a_ref| / |a_ref| <= 3e-4 (physics.requirement). The per-sample errors are reported
gates.L_G4_GRADIENT: on the L_G2 samples: the production forward-mode gradient equals the complex-step Jacobian (h = 1e-30 m) of a complex-safe reference implementation of the same discrete rule, written in the test (branches chosen on real parts), to <= 1e-10 relative (Frobenius); that reference's value equals the C6 kernel to <= 1e-12. The numba and py_func gradients agree to <= 1e-12
gates.L_G5_VARIATIONAL: S1 T_G5 geometry (synthetic moving Earth and Sun, 100 km circular polar orbit, Moon J2 on, 6 h sampled every 300 s), SRP NO_SHADOW with K = 0.05 m^2/kg (5x the physical prior so the LRP effect sits well above the oracle noise; F2p estimated 0.0745), LRP on, production propagators at DOP853 rtol 1e-13 atol 1e-14. Oracle: fixed-step RK4 (5 s) re-propagation of the PRODUCTION LRP-on 6-state RHS, central differences with h = 3 m and 3e-3 m/s (chosen from the S1 exploratory diagnostic, which put the noise / truncation balance near 3x S1's steps). (a) max over columns of max|FD_j - Phi e_j| / max|Phi e_j| <= 1e-7; negative control, an analysis-only replica with LRP in the trajectory and no LRP gradient in the variational block: error >= 10 x the gated error. (b) dK = 5e-3: max|FD_K - s_K| / max|s_K| <= 1e-6. (c) RHS structure at random states, no integration: LRP-on minus LRP-off equals [0, K g] in 0:6, K G @ Phi[0:3, :] in rows 3:6 of Phi_dot and K G @ s_K[0:3] + g in s_K_dot[3:6], each to 4 eps of the base element magnitude, nothing else moves; the 6-state path never evaluates the gradient
gates.L_G6_PATH_CONSISTENCY: L_G5 geometry with LRP on, and again with LRP and the S1 tide on together: positions from the 6-, 42- (numba and reference) and 48-state propagations agree to 1e-5 m and Phi to 1e-8 of max|Phi|. The S1 zonal synthetic harmonic model with harmonic_stm_opt_in gives the same agreement
gates.L_G7_SHADOW_EVENTS: S1 T_G7 geometry (1 day, Sun in the orbit plane), SRP CONICAL_PENUMBRA K = 0.05, shadow_events True, DOP853 rtol 1e-11 atol 1e-12, LRP on. (a) 6-, 42- and 48-state propagations complete and the contact check passes at every cut. (b) LRP moves at least one cut by more than _CONTACT_TIME_TOL_S (1e-3 s) from the LRP-free cuts. (c) Segmenting the LRP-on RHS at the LRP-free cuts raises the contact-consistency RuntimeError
gates.L_G8_FAIL_CLOSED: each design.validation case raises, including lunar_radiation with srp None and with SRPOptions(enabled=False), at every propagation entry point that takes the keyword
gates.L_G9_REGRESSION: full pytest: 0 failures, 0 errors, skips unchanged apart from the new tests' own; tools/check_repository.py passes; the protected-file re-freeze is additive (a new F3_WP3_2_S2 table first in expected_current_tree_sha256, history unchanged, the history-chain tests extended)
gates.LB_G1_OPTIONS: as S1 B_G1, for every combination of lunar_tide in {None, TIDE} and lunar_radiation in {None, LRP}: without lunar_radiation the dicts equal the S1 dicts; with it they additionally hold exactly that object under 'lunar_radiation'. A non-options value raises TypeError
gates.LB_G2_TRANSPORT: as S1 B_G2: spies on every propagation entry point estimators.py calls, for the six public estimators (two-way with and without K solve-for): every captured call carries the given LunarRadiationOptions object, and with lunar_radiation omitted no call has the key
gates.LB_G3_RECOVERY: S1 B_G3 setup (noiseless position observations every 300 s on the 6 h arc) with truth from propagate_state with SRP NO_SHADOW K = 0.05 and LRP on (DOP853 rtol 1e-12 atol 1e-13). estimate_position_bls_lm and estimate_position_srif with the same SRP, LRP and PropagationProfile(), started 100 m and 0.1 m/s off: |dr0| < 1e-3 m and |dv0| < 1e-6 m/s; the same solve without LRP has |dr0| >= 100 x the LRP-on value

expectations: stated before the run, not gates: L_G2 ~1e-15 (summation order only); L_G3(a) and (b) ~1e-13 (smooth integrands under the x^2 Gauss-Legendre map); L_G3(c) ~1e-6..1e-4, worst where a radiance kink crosses the cap at 20 km, with a real chance of exceeding 3e-4 there; L_G4 ~1e-13; L_G5(a) gated ~2e-8..5e-8, control ~1e-6..4e-6 (the LRP gradient at K = 0.05 is ~0.15 of the S1 tide gradient, whose control gave 2.3e-5); L_G7 cut shifts of several ms (WP3.1: ~4 m per day at K = 0.01); per-call cost of the numba kernel ~100-300 us for the value and ~3-5x that with the gradient
out_of_scope: the Earth's shadow on the lunar surface during eclipses and thermal lag (both lower the LRP in the umbral phases; WP3.1 section 8 notes the overestimate), albedo and temperature maps (Diviner, LOLA), a different K for the IR (K_LRP = K_SRP by the WP3.1 model), a faster or kink-aware quadrature (it would change the term WP3.1 measured), the LRP in UKF/EKF/fast sigma/scenario/config/CLI/desktop/observability/numerical metadata/force contract (design.deferred)
reject_if: if any gate fails, S2 is reported as computed and not offered for merge until a fix passes a gate set recorded in docs/assurance/amendment-log.md; a change to a gate after its result is exploratory (amendment log)
agent_decisions: agent decisions under the owner's 2026-11-08 delegation, flagged for review: (1) the C6 model and quadrature unchanged, so production equals the term WP3.1 measured, with its accuracy gated against the materiality requirement instead of replaced by a different rule; (2) a separate LunarRadiationOptions and keyword instead of a new SRPOptions field, because asdict(SRPOptions) is recorded in numerical metadata and archives, and a new field would change every SRP-enabled record; (3) K_LRP = K_SRP, and LRP requires active SRP; (4) a numba loop kernel with forward-mode gradient, because the numpy kernel costs 3.7 ms per call; (5) K = 0.05 and 3x the S1 difference steps in the variational gates, chosen before any S2 number; (6) the additive re-freeze of dynamics.py and estimators.py; (7) one branch and PR per slice, stacked on #116
